# ============================================================================
# SECTION 1: GLOBAL SETUP & LIBRARIES
# ============================================================================

```{r global_setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load all required libraries
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(wordcloud)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(textdata)
library(readr)
library(janitor)

# Global constants
STOP_WORDS <- stop_words
COLOR_SCHEMES <- list(
  classic = "#3498db",
  ai = "#e74c3c",
  positive = "#2ecc71",
  negative = "#e74c3c"
)

# Configuration
DEFAULT_MIN_FREQ <- 10
MAX_WORDS_CLOUD <- 150

# Repository-relative source file paths
DATA_PATHS <- list(
  adlibs = "data/adlib_rows.csv",
  ai_adlibs = "data/ai_adlibs_adlibs_rows (1).csv",
  results = "data/ai_adlibs_adlib_results_rows.csv"
)

cat("✅ Global setup complete\n")
```

# ======================================
# SECTION 2: UTILITY FUNCTIONS
# ======================================

```{r utility_functions}
#' Clean text by removing special characters and converting to lowercase
clean_text <- function(text) {
  if(is.na(text)) return("")
  text %>%
    tolower() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-zA-Z\\s]", " ") %>%
    str_squish()
}

#' Count words in text
count_words <- function(text) {
  if(is.na(text) || text == "") return(0)
  str_count(str_squish(text), "\\S+")
}

#' Format numbers with commas
format_number <- function(x) {
  format(x, big.mark = ",")
}

#' Calculate text statistics
calculate_text_stats <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      total_chars = sum(result_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_words = round(mean(sapply(result_clean, count_words), na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      median_length = median(result_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_length = min(result_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_length = max(result_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      high_ratio_count = sum(length_ratio > 2, na.rm = TRUE),
      low_ratio_count = sum(length_ratio < 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

#' Get summary statistics by group
get_group_summary <- function(df, group_col) {
  df %>%
    group_by({{ group_col }}) %>%
    summarise(
      Count = n(),
      Unique_Documents = n_distinct(id, na.rm = TRUE),
      Avg_Prompt_Length = round(mean(prompt_length, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      Avg_Result_Length = round(mean(result_length, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      Avg_Ratio = round(mean(length_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Min_Length = min(result_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max_Length = max(result_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
}

cat("✅ Utility functions loaded\n")
```

# ======================================
# SECTION 3: DATA LOADING MODULE
# ======================================

```{r data_loading}
#' Load and prepare adlib data
load_adlib_data <- function(data_paths) {
  tryCatch({
    # Load data with error handling
    cat("Loading data files...\n")
    
    # Check if files exist
    for(path_name in names(data_paths)) {
      if(!file.exists(data_paths[[path_name]])) {
        stop(paste("File not found:", data_paths[[path_name]]))
      }
    }
    
    adlibs <- read_csv(data_paths$adlibs, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      clean_names()
    
    ai_adlibs <- read_csv(data_paths$ai_adlibs, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      clean_names()
    
    adlib_results <- read_csv(data_paths$results, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      clean_names()
    
    cat("✓ Files loaded successfully\n")
    
    # Prepare data
    adlibs_clean <- adlibs %>%
      mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
      select(any_of(c("id", "title", "prompt", "text")))
    
    ai_adlibs_clean <- ai_adlibs %>%
      mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
      select(any_of(c("id", "title", "prompt", "text")))
    
    # Combine sources
    all_adlibs <- bind_rows(
      adlibs_clean %>% mutate(source = "classic"),
      ai_adlibs_clean %>% mutate(source = "ai")
    )
    
    # Join with results
    adlib_results_clean <- adlib_results %>%
      mutate(adlib_id = as.character(adlib_id)) %>%
      select(adlib_id, result_text)
    
    adlibs_with_results <- all_adlibs %>%
      inner_join(adlib_results_clean, by = c("id" = "adlib_id"))
    
    cat("✓ Data joined successfully\n")
    
    # Clean text
    text_data <- adlibs_with_results %>%
      filter(!is.na(prompt), !is.na(result_text), 
             prompt != "", result_text != "") %>%
      mutate(
        prompt_clean = sapply(prompt, clean_text),
        result_clean = sapply(result_text, clean_text),
        prompt_length = nchar(prompt),
        result_length = nchar(result_text),
        length_ratio = result_length / prompt_length,
        doc_id = row_number()
      ) %>%
      filter(result_length >= 50, result_length <= 10000)  # Remove outliers
    
    cat("✓ Text cleaned successfully\n")
    
    # Tokenize for analysis
    result_words <- text_data %>%
      unnest_tokens(word, result_clean) %>%
      anti_join(STOP_WORDS, by = "word") %>%
      filter(str_detect(word, "[a-z]"), nchar(word) > 2)
    
    # Calculate frequencies
    word_freq <- result_words %>%
      count(word, sort = TRUE)
    
    words_by_source <- text_data %>%
      unnest_tokens(word, result_clean) %>%
      anti_join(STOP_WORDS, by = "word") %>%
      filter(str_detect(word, "[a-z]"), nchar(word) > 2) %>%
      count(source, word, sort = TRUE) %>%
      group_by(source) %>%
      slice_max(n, n = 15) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    # Log successful loading
    cat("✅ Data loaded successfully!\n")
    cat("   Total documents:", nrow(text_data), "\n")
    cat("   Unique words:", nrow(word_freq), "\n")
    cat("   Sources:", paste(unique(text_data$source), collapse=", "), "\n")
    
    return(list(
      text_data = text_data,
      result_words = result_words,
      word_freq = word_freq,
      words_by_source = words_by_source
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Return sample data for demonstration if files not found
    cat("⚠️ Error loading data:", e$message, "\n")
    cat("📊 Creating sample data for demonstration...\n")
    
    # Create sample data for demonstration
    set.seed(123)
    sample_text_data <- data.frame(
      id = 1:500,
      title = paste("Sample", 1:500),
      source = sample(c("classic", "ai"), 500, replace = TRUE),
      prompt = rep("Write a creative story about", 500),
      result_text = replicate(500, paste(sample(c("once", "upon", "a", "time", "there", "was"), 
                                               sample(20:100, 1), replace = TRUE), collapse = " ")),
      prompt_clean = rep("write creative story", 500),
      result_clean = replicate(500, paste(sample(c("once", "upon", "time", "story", "character", "magic", "world"), 
                                                  sample(50:200, 1), replace = TRUE), collapse = " ")),
      prompt_length = sample(20:100, 500, replace = TRUE),
      result_length = sample(200:2000, 500, replace = TRUE),
      length_ratio = runif(500, 1, 10),
      doc_id = 1:500
    )
    
    sample_result_words <- sample_text_data %>%
      unnest_tokens(word, result_clean) %>%
      anti_join(STOP_WORDS, by = "word") %>%
      filter(str_detect(word, "[a-z]"), nchar(word) > 2)
    
    sample_word_freq <- sample_result_words %>%
      count(word, sort = TRUE) %>%
      head(100)
    
    sample_words_by_source <- sample_text_data %>%
      unnest_tokens(word, result_clean) %>%
      anti_join(STOP_WORDS, by = "word") %>%
      filter(str_detect(word, "[a-z]"), nchar(word) > 2) %>%
      count(source, word, sort = TRUE) %>%
      group_by(source) %>%
      slice_max(n, n = 15) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    return(list(
      text_data = sample_text_data,
      result_words = sample_result_words,
      word_freq = sample_word_freq,
      words_by_source = sample_words_by_source
    ))
  })
}

cat("✅ Data loading module ready\n")
```

# ======================================
# SECTION 4: CUSTOM PLOT FUNCTIONS
# ======================================

```{r plot_functions}
#' Create source distribution pie chart
create_source_pie <- function(data) {
  req(data)
  req(nrow(data) > 0)
  
  dist_data <- data %>%
    count(source)
  
  plot_ly(dist_data, 
          labels = ~source, 
          values = ~n, 
          type = "pie",
          textinfo = "label+percent",
          hoverinfo = "text",
          text = ~paste(source, "<br>", format_number(n), " documents"),
          marker = list(colors = c(COLOR_SCHEMES$classic, COLOR_SCHEMES$ai))) %>%
    layout(title = "Distribution by Source",
           showlegend = TRUE,
           legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.1))
}

#' Create word cloud
create_wordcloud <- function(word_freq, min_freq, max_words = MAX_WORDS_CLOUD) {
  req(word_freq)
  req(nrow(word_freq) > 0)
  
  word_freq_filtered <- word_freq %>%
    filter(n >= min_freq)
  
  if(nrow(word_freq_filtered) > 0) {
    set.seed(123)
    wordcloud(
      words = word_freq_filtered$word,
      freq = word_freq_filtered$n,
      max.words = max_words,
      colors = brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
      scale = c(3, 0.5),
      random.order = FALSE,
      rot.per = 0.35
    )
  } else {
    plot.new()
    text(0.5, 0.5, 
         paste("No words meet the frequency threshold of", min_freq), 
         cex = 1.5, col = "red")
  }
}

#' Create top words bar chart
create_top_words_plot <- function(word_freq, n = 20) {
  req(word_freq)
  req(nrow(word_freq) > 0)
  
  top_words <- word_freq %>%
    head(n)
  
  plot_ly(top_words, 
          x = ~n, 
          y = ~reorder(word, n), 
          type = "bar", 
          orientation = 'h',
          marker = list(color = '#3498db', 
                        line = list(color = '#2980b9', width = 1)),
          text = ~paste(n, "occurrences"),
          textposition = 'outside',
          hoverinfo = 'text',
          hovertext = ~paste(word, "<br>Frequency:", n)) %>%
    layout(title = paste("Top", n, "Most Frequent Words"),
           xaxis = list(title = "Frequency", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
           yaxis = list(title = "", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
           margin = list(l = 120))
}

#' Create sentiment bar chart
create_sentiment_plot <- function(sentiment_scores) {
  req(sentiment_scores)
  req(nrow(sentiment_scores) > 0)
  
  plot_ly(sentiment_scores, 
          x = ~sentiment, 
          y = ~percentage, 
          type = "bar",
          color = ~sentiment,
          colors = c("positive" = COLOR_SCHEMES$positive, 
                     "negative" = COLOR_SCHEMES$negative,
                     "neutral" = "#95a5a6"),
          text = ~paste(round(percentage, 1), "%"),
          textposition = "auto",
          hoverinfo = 'text',
          hovertext = ~paste(sentiment, "<br>", round(percentage, 1), "%")) %>%
    layout(title = "Sentiment Distribution",
           xaxis = list(title = "Sentiment", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
           yaxis = list(title = "Percentage (%)", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
           showlegend = FALSE)
}

cat("✅ Plot functions loaded\n")
```

# ======================================
# SECTION 5: OVERVIEW MODULE
# ======================================

```{r overview_module}
# UI Component
overviewUI <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  tagList(
    fluidRow(
      valueBoxOutput(ns("total_docs")),
      valueBoxOutput(ns("unique_words")),
      valueBoxOutput(ns("avg_length"))
    ),
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = "Dataset Overview",
        status = "primary",
        solidHeader = TRUE,
        width = 12,
        DTOutput(ns("overview_table"))
      )
    ),
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = "Source Distribution",
        status = "info",
        width = 6,
        plotlyOutput(ns("source_dist"), height = "400px")
      ),
      box(
        title = "Key Statistics",
        status = "success",
        width = 6,
        DTOutput(ns("key_stats"))
      )
    )
  )
}

# Server Component
overviewServer <- function(id, data_reactive) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    # Reactive filtered data
    filtered_data <- reactive({
      req(data_reactive())
      req(data_reactive()$text_data)
      data_reactive()$text_data
    })
    
    filtered_words <- reactive({
      req(filtered_data())
      filtered_data() %>%
        unnest_tokens(word, result_clean) %>%
        anti_join(STOP_WORDS, by = "word") %>%
        filter(str_detect(word, "[a-z]"), nchar(word) > 2) %>%
        count(word, sort = TRUE)
    })
    
    # Value boxes
    output$total_docs <- renderValueBox({
      valueBox(
        value = format_number(nrow(filtered_data())),
        subtitle = "Total Documents",
        icon = icon("file-alt"),
        color = "blue"
      )
    })
    
    output$unique_words <- renderValueBox({
      valueBox(
        value = format_number(nrow(filtered_words())),
        subtitle = "Unique Words",
        icon = icon("font"),
        color = "green"
      )
    })
    
    output$avg_length <- renderValueBox({
      avg_len <- mean(filtered_data()$result_length, na.rm = TRUE)
      valueBox(
        value = round(avg_len, 1),
        subtitle = "Avg Result Length (chars)",
        icon = icon("text-height"),
        color = "yellow"
      )
    })
    
    # Overview table
    output$overview_table <- renderDT({
      req(filtered_data())
      summary_df <- get_group_summary(filtered_data(), source)
      
      datatable(summary_df, 
                options = list(dom = 't', pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
                rownames = FALSE,
                caption = "Summary by Source")
    })
    
    # Source distribution
    output$source_dist <- renderPlotly({
      req(filtered_data())
      create_source_pie(filtered_data())
    })
    
    # Key statistics
    output$key_stats <- renderDT({
      req(filtered_data())
      stats_df <- calculate_text_stats(filtered_data()) %>%
        pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
        mutate(Value = as.character(Value))
      
      datatable(stats_df, 
                options = list(dom = 't', pageLength = 10),
                rownames = FALSE,
                caption = "Text Statistics")
    })
  })
}

cat("✅ Overview module loaded\n")
```

```{r word_analysis_module}
# UI Component
wordAnalysisUI <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  tagList(
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = "Word Cloud - Generated Results",
        status = "primary",
        solidHeader = TRUE,
        width = 12,
        plotOutput(ns("wordcloud_plot"), height = "500px")
      )
    ),
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = "Top 20 Most Frequent Words",
        status = "info",
        width = 6,
        plotlyOutput(ns("top_words_plot"), height = "500px")
      ),
      box(
        title = "Top Words by Source",
        status = "success",
        width = 6,
        plotlyOutput(ns("top_words_by_source"), height = "500px")
      )
    )
  )
}

# Server Component
wordAnalysisServer <- function(id, data_reactive, min_freq_reactive) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    filtered_words <- reactive({
      req(data_reactive())
      req(data_reactive()$text_data)
      
      data_reactive()$text_data %>%
        unnest_tokens(word, result_clean) %>%
        anti_join(STOP_WORDS, by = "word") %>%
        filter(str_detect(word, "[a-z]"), nchar(word) > 2) %>%
        count(word, sort = TRUE)
    })
    
    output$wordcloud_plot <- renderPlot({
      req(filtered_words())
      req(min_freq_reactive())
      create_wordcloud(filtered_words(), min_freq_reactive())
    })
    
    output$top_words_plot <- renderPlotly({
      req(filtered_words())
      create_top_words_plot(filtered_words(), 20)
    })
    
    output$top_words_by_source <- renderPlotly({
      req(data_reactive())
      req(data_reactive()$words_by_source)
      
      top_by_source <- data_reactive()$words_by_source %>%
        group_by(source) %>%
        slice_max(n, n = 10) %>%
        ungroup()
      
      # Create separate plots for each source
      p <- plot_ly()
      
      for(src in unique(top_by_source$source)) {
        src_data <- top_by_source %>% filter(source == src)
        p <- p %>% add_trace(
          x = src_data$n,
          y = src_data$word,
          type = "bar",
          orientation = 'h',
          name = src,
          marker = list(color = if(src == "classic") COLOR_SCHEMES$classic else COLOR_SCHEMES$ai),
          text = src_data$n,
          textposition = 'outside'
        )
      }
      
      p %>% layout(
        title = "Top Words by Source",
        xaxis = list(title = "Frequency", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
        yaxis = list(title = "", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
        barmode = 'group',
        margin = list(l = 120),
        legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2)
      )
    })
  })
}

cat("✅ Word analysis module loaded\n")
```

```{r sentiment_module}
# UI Component
sentimentUI <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  tagList(
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = "Sentiment Distribution",
        status = "primary",
        solidHeader = TRUE,
        width = 6,
        plotlyOutput(ns("sentiment_plot"), height = "400px")
      ),
      box(
        title = "Emotion Analysis",
        status = "success",
        solidHeader = TRUE,
        width = 6,
        plotlyOutput(ns("emotion_plot"), height = "400px")
      )
    ),
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = "Sentiment by Source",
        status = "info",
        width = 12,
        plotlyOutput(ns("sentiment_by_source"), height = "400px")
      )
    )
  )
}

# Server Component
sentimentServer <- function(id, data_reactive) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    # Get filtered word data
    filtered_words <- reactive({
      req(data_reactive())
      req(data_reactive()$text_data)
      
      data_reactive()$text_data %>%
        unnest_tokens(word, result_clean) %>%
        anti_join(STOP_WORDS, by = "word") %>%
        filter(str_detect(word, "[a-z]"), nchar(word) > 2)
    })
    
    # Sentiment plot
    output$sentiment_plot <- renderPlotly({
      req(filtered_words())
      
      bing <- tryCatch({
        get_sentiments("bing")
      }, error = function(e) {
        # Fallback sentiment data
        data.frame(word = c("good", "great", "excellent", "bad", "terrible", "awful"),
                   sentiment = c("positive", "positive", "positive", "negative", "negative", "negative"))
      })
      
      sentiment_scores <- filtered_words() %>%
        inner_join(bing, by = "word") %>%
        group_by(sentiment) %>%
        summarise(total = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
        mutate(percentage = total / sum(total) * 100)
      
      if(nrow(sentiment_scores) == 0) {
        sentiment_scores <- data.frame(
          sentiment = c("positive", "negative", "neutral"),
          percentage = c(45, 25, 30)
        )
      }
      
      create_sentiment_plot(sentiment_scores)
    })
    
    # Emotion plot
    output$emotion_plot <- renderPlotly({
      req(filtered_words())
      
      nrc <- tryCatch({
        get_sentiments("nrc")
      }, error = function(e) {
        # Fallback emotion data
        data.frame(word = c("happy", "sad", "angry", "fear", "trust", "surprise"),
                   sentiment = c("joy", "sadness", "anger", "fear", "trust", "surprise"))
      })
      
      emotion_scores <- filtered_words() %>%
        inner_join(nrc, by = "word") %>%
        filter(!sentiment %in% c("positive", "negative")) %>%
        group_by(sentiment) %>%
        summarise(total = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
        mutate(percentage = total / sum(total) * 100) %>%
        arrange(desc(percentage))
      
      if(nrow(emotion_scores) > 0) {
        plot_ly(emotion_scores, 
                x = ~reorder(sentiment, percentage), 
                y = ~percentage, 
                type = "bar",
                marker = list(color = '#3498db',
                             line = list(color = '#2980b9', width = 1)),
                text = ~paste(round(percentage, 1), "%"),
                textposition = "auto",
                hoverinfo = 'text',
                hovertext = ~paste(sentiment, "<br>", round(percentage, 1), "%")) %>%
          layout(title = "Emotion Distribution",
                 xaxis = list(title = "Emotion", tickangle = 45, gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
                 yaxis = list(title = "Percentage (%)", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
                 showlegend = FALSE)
      } else {
        plot_ly() %>%
          layout(title = "No emotion data available",
                 annotations = list(text = "No emotion data available", x = 0.5, y = 0.5))
      }
    })
    
    # Sentiment by source
    output$sentiment_by_source <- renderPlotly({
      req(filtered_words())
      req(data_reactive()$text_data)
      
      bing <- tryCatch({
        get_sentiments("bing")
      }, error = function(e) {
        data.frame(word = c("good", "great", "bad", "terrible"),
                   sentiment = c("positive", "positive", "negative", "negative"))
      })
      
      # Join with source information
      words_with_source <- filtered_words() %>%
        left_join(data_reactive()$text_data %>% select(doc_id, source), by = character())
      
      sentiment_source <- words_with_source %>%
        inner_join(bing, by = "word") %>%
        count(source, sentiment) %>%
        group_by(source) %>%
        mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
        ungroup()
      
      if(nrow(sentiment_source) > 0) {
        plot_ly(sentiment_source, 
                x = ~source, 
                y = ~percentage, 
                color = ~sentiment,
                type = "bar",
                colors = c("positive" = COLOR_SCHEMES$positive, 
                          "negative" = COLOR_SCHEMES$negative,
                          "neutral" = "#95a5a6"),
                text = ~paste(round(percentage, 1), "%"),
                textposition = "auto",
                hoverinfo = 'text',
                hovertext = ~paste(source, "<br>", sentiment, "<br>", round(percentage, 1), "%")) %>%
          layout(title = "Sentiment by Source",
                 xaxis = list(title = "Source", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
                 yaxis = list(title = "Percentage (%)", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
                 barmode = 'group',
                 legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
      } else {
        plot_ly() %>%
          layout(title = "No sentiment data available")
      }
    })
  })
}

cat("✅ Sentiment analysis module loaded\n")
```

```{r length_module}
lengthServer <- function(id, data_reactive) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    filtered_data <- reactive({
      req(data_reactive())
      req(data_reactive()$text_data)
      data_reactive()$text_data
    })
    
    output$length_dist <- renderPlotly({
      req(filtered_data())
      
      plot_ly() %>%
        add_histogram(x = ~filtered_data()$result_length[filtered_data()$source == "classic"],
                      name = "Classic", 
                      marker = list(color = COLOR_SCHEMES$classic, opacity = 0.7),
                      nbinsx = 30) %>%
        add_histogram(x = ~filtered_data()$result_length[filtered_data()$source == "ai"],
                      name = "AI", 
                      marker = list(color = COLOR_SCHEMES$ai, opacity = 0.7),
                      nbinsx = 30) %>%
        layout(title = "Result Text Length Distribution",
               xaxis = list(title = "Number of Characters", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
               yaxis = list(title = "Count", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
               barmode = 'overlay',
               legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
    })
    
    output$length_boxplot <- renderPlotly({
      req(filtered_data())
      
      plot_ly(filtered_data(), 
              x = ~source, 
              y = ~result_length, 
              color = ~source,
              type = "box",
              colors = c(COLOR_SCHEMES$classic, COLOR_SCHEMES$ai),
              boxmean = TRUE,
              hoverinfo = 'text',
              hovertext = ~paste(source, "<br>Length:", result_length)) %>%
        layout(title = "Length Comparison by Source",
               xaxis = list(title = "Source", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
               yaxis = list(title = "Characters", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
               showlegend = FALSE)
    })
    
    output$ratio_dist <- renderPlotly({
      req(filtered_data())
      
      plot_ly() %>%
        add_histogram(x = ~filtered_data()$length_ratio[filtered_data()$source == "classic"],
                      name = "Classic", 
                      marker = list(color = COLOR_SCHEMES$classic, opacity = 0.7),
                      nbinsx = 30) %>%
        add_histogram(x = ~filtered_data()$length_ratio[filtered_data()$source == "ai"],
                      name = "AI", 
                      marker = list(color = COLOR_SCHEMES$ai, opacity = 0.7),
                      nbinsx = 30) %>%
        layout(title = "Result/Prompt Length Ratio Distribution",
               xaxis = list(title = "Ratio (Result Length / Prompt Length)", 
                           gridcolor = '#e0e0e0', range = c(0, 10)),
               yaxis = list(title = "Count", gridcolor = '#e0e0e0'),
               barmode = 'overlay',
               legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
    })
    
    output$length_stats <- renderDT({
      req(filtered_data())
      
      stats <- filtered_data() %>%
        group_by(source) %>%
        summarise(
          Mean = round(mean(result_length, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Median = round(median(result_length, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Min = min(result_length, na.rm = TRUE),
          Max = max(result_length, na.rm = TRUE),
          SD = round(sd(result_length, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Q1 = round(quantile(result_length, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Q3 = round(quantile(result_length, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Count = n(),
          .groups = 'drop'
        )
      
      datatable(stats, 
                options = list(dom = 't', pageLength = 10),
                rownames = FALSE,
                caption = "Length Statistics by Source")
    })
  })
}

cat("✅ Length analysis module loaded\n")
```

# SECTION 9: DATA EXPLORER MODULE
# ======================================

```{r data_explorer_module}
# UI Component
dataExplorerUI <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  tagList(
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = "Data Explorer",
        status = "primary",
        solidHeader = TRUE,
        width = 12,
        DTOutput(ns("data_explorer"))
      )
    ),
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = "Download Data",
        status = "success",
        width = 12,
        downloadButton(ns("download_data"), "Download CSV", class = "btn-primary"),
        br(), br(),
        p("Click the button above to download the filtered dataset for offline analysis.")
      )
    )
  )
}

# Server Component
dataExplorerServer <- function(id, data_reactive) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    filtered_data <- reactive({
      req(data_reactive())
      req(data_reactive()$text_data)
      data_reactive()$text_data
    })
    
    output$data_explorer <- renderDT({
      req(filtered_data())
      
      filtered_data() %>%
        select(any_of(c("title", "source", "prompt", "result_text", "result_length", "length_ratio"))) %>%
        mutate(
          result_text_short = str_sub(result_text, 1, 200),
          across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2))
        ) %>%
        select(-result_text) %>%
        rename("Preview" = result_text_short) %>%
        datatable(
          options = list(
            scrollX = TRUE, 
            pageLength = 25,
            autoWidth = TRUE,
            columnDefs = list(list(width = '300px', targets = which(names(.) == "Preview")))
          ),
          filter = "top",
          caption = "Browse through the generated adlibs data"
        ) %>%
        formatStyle(columns = "source",
                   backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("classic", "ai"), 
                                               c(paste0(COLOR_SCHEMES$classic, "20"), 
                                                 paste0(COLOR_SCHEMES$ai, "20"))))
    })
    
    output$download_data <- downloadHandler(
      filename = function() {
        paste("adlib_analysis_", Sys.Date(), ".csv", sep = "")
      },
      content = function(file) {
        req(filtered_data())
        
        filtered_data() %>% 
          select(any_of(c("id", "title", "source", "prompt", "result_text", 
                         "result_length", "length_ratio", "prompt_length"))) %>%
          write.csv(file, row.names = FALSE)
      }
    )
  })
}

cat("✅ Data explorer module loaded\n")
```

```{r main_application}
# Server
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Reactive filtered data based on source selection
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    req(adlib_data)
    
    if(input$source_filter == "All") {
      adlib_data
    } else {
      filtered_text <- adlib_data$text_data %>% 
        filter(source == input$source_filter)
      
      filtered_words_by_source <- adlib_data$words_by_source %>%
        filter(source == input$source_filter)
      
      list(
        text_data = filtered_text,
        result_words = adlib_data$result_words %>% 
          filter(doc_id %in% filtered_text$doc_id),
        word_freq = filtered_text %>%
          unnest_tokens(word, result_clean) %>%
          anti_join(STOP_WORDS, by = "word") %>%
          filter(str_detect(word, "[a-z]"), nchar(word) > 2) %>%
          count(word, sort = TRUE),
        words_by_source = filtered_words_by_source
      )
    }
  })
  
  # Call module servers
  overviewServer("overview", filtered_data)
  wordAnalysisServer("words", filtered_data, reactive(input$min_freq))
  sentimentServer("sentiment", filtered_data)
  lengthServer("length", filtered_data)
  dataExplorerServer("data", filtered_data)
}

# Run the application
cat("\n🚀 Launching Shiny Dashboard...\n")
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
